text: ok i see the ghost now, next i want to see live updates. currently i click and it apparently places the thing but i dont see it until reloading
resolution: Made loader-pane placements visible without a manual reload, two parts. (1) The debounced auto-compile keyed only on worldRev/placements, but a build-piece commit bumps the build stream (mapBuildRev) not worldRev, so placements never re-armed the bake — added buildPieces to the effect deps. (2) Since a full bake is ~5s, the HUD now draws every piece committed-since-last-bake as an instant amber wireframe box (tracking the baked id set, refreshed each reload) so a placement shows the instant you click, replaced by the real mesh on reload. Superseded in direction by req_1798/1799 (the whole rebake-per-edit loop is too slow AND the in-place gamefile write is corruption-prone); these two changes still stand as improvements.
